title: A gap-research sprint review reads each closing note against the line it cites
goal: the sprint review step for a gap-research sprint has the reviewer read every closing note dated in the sprint against the article line it cites and flag a note that claims more than that line states

run: import sys; s=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read(); i=s.find('## review'); j=s.find('## close'); sys.exit(0 if 'against the line it cites' in s[i:j] else 1)

notes: SP-ovwzbc7u review: three closing notes in kb/public/_gaps.md (arXiv licence, CIS benchmark list, robocopy KB articles) claimed more than the tagged line they cite; the cite check of ST-y627kmds passes on any tagged line. Fixed by ST-3jedztcz.
